pr_title: Fix multiplayer leave dialog not working on all exit operations
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/13608 and fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/13609.

Not sure about the tests. I feel like the back button / home & os close tests are too indirect because there is no `OsuGame`. I didn't do it in `TestSceneScreenNavigation` as it didn't have an existing way to create rooms and I can't seem to make it work. Either way, I thought it would bloat up that global test even more.

issue_context.title: Pressing back in multiplayer freemod selection screen doesn't close freemod seletion screen

**Describe the bug:** 

Pressing back or <kbd>Esc</kbd> doesn't close freemod selection. Instead, it will try to exit the room.
Pressing back usually closes mod selection screens.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

The back button that doesn't behave as expected:

![osu_2021-06-22_01-52-35](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16479013/122842043-d7db5800-d2fc-11eb-961a-0034f4c7d1a3.png)


**osu!lazer version:** 2021.619.1

**Logs:** N/A

review_comments: Was there a specific reason for changing this to pushing the dialog button instead of proceeding with exit? Just checking because in theory they should both behave the same way.
No reason. I just copied what main menu and editor did.
